## [1.46.0](https://github.com/PerfLite/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.46.0) (2026-10-05)

### ⚡ Upstream 1.45.0 Sync & Features

* **Upstream 1.45.0 updates merged:** Support for YouTube 21.39.522, YouTube Music 9.38.51, Reddit 2026.39.0 / 2026.24.0.
* **New upstream patches & improvements:** Spoof signature, Animated startup Morphe logo, Picture-in-picture button, Playback buffer size option, Volume boost for swipe controls, Litho renderer enforcement, Force portrait orientation, Jam queue sharing, and many bug fixes.
* **Voice-Over Translation (VOT):** Full Yandex neural voice dubbing with Lively Voice (Живой голос), updated browser headers/constants, automatic language detection, volume ducking, and rate-limiting protections.
